text: when request the ResponseSystem shall within 3 ticks satisfy response
description:
SCOPE: in the interval defined by the entire execution.
TRIGGER: first point in the interval if (request) is true and any point in the interval where (request) becomes true (from false).
REQUIRED BEHAVIOR: for every trigger, (response) must hold at some point with distance <= 3 from the trigger (i.e., at trigger, trigger+1, ..., or trigger+3). If the interval ends sooner than trigger+3, then (response) need not hold.
